name: Pratap Malla
description: Malla king and poet; patron of Kathmandu Durbar Square monuments.
biography: Seventh king of Kantipur; credited with expansion of Taleju and public performance culture.
supporting_source_citation: UNESCO. Kathmandu Valley. World Heritage List, property 121. https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/121/

name: Siddhi Narsingh Malla
description: Malla king of Patan; patron of Krishna Mandir (stone Shikhara).
biography: Known for Sanskrit learning and Krishnaite devotion in Patan.
supporting_source_authors: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation
supporting_source_citation: Department of Archaeology, Nepal. Official website. https://www.archaeology.gov.np/ (accessed for heritage permits and notices).

name: Amshuvarman
description: Licchavi-era ruler linked to early palace and waterworks.
biography: First Nepalese historical figure attested in inscriptions as Mahasamanta.
supporting_source_citation: UNESCO. State of conservation reports and mission reports for property 121. https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/121/documents/
